# Retained 0.1.0 compatibility data

Historical data of release 0.1.0, generated once from its source commit
`0da12492ba11c2b86fa44c7285031238aa1d499e` (the commit staged as 0.1.0) for
[#21](https://github.com/descipar/wled-mcp/issues/21) (TD-21-9, ISSUE-21-DEC-002). Later
servers are tested against these files by `tests/test_upgrade_compat.py`; they are never
regenerated by a later server and never edited to make a test pass. A breaking change is
announced by a migration note in
[docs/contract/versioning.md](../../../../docs/contract/versioning.md#migration-notes)
instead.

All content is synthetic: reserved example hosts, a mock transport, a fixed clock, no
device.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `tools.json` | The complete served `tools/list` of 0.1.0 (name, description, input and output schema, annotations), dumped with `model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)` |
| `config.toml` | `examples/devices.example.toml` of 0.1.0, validated by the 0.1.0 `load_config` (`schema_version = 1`) |
| `snapshots/desk/b-*.json` | One preset snapshot (`format_version` 1) written by the 0.1.0 `SnapshotStore`; the tests copy it to `<data dir>/backups/desk/` (`backups/` itself is ignored by Git) |
| `get_state.json` | One `wled_get_state` envelope of 0.1.0 for a synthetic WLED 16.0.1 device; `read_at` set to the fixed generation time |
| `generate.py` | The generator; it refuses to run with any other package version |

## Regeneration (only to reproduce, not to update)

From a checkout of this repository, with uv and Python 3.13, offline:

```text
git archive 0da12492ba11c2b86fa44c7285031238aa1d499e | tar -x -C <empty dir>
cd <empty dir>
uv sync --frozen --offline --no-dev
uv run --frozen --offline --no-dev python <checkout>/tests/fixtures/compat/0.1.0/generate.py --source . --output <checkout>/tests/fixtures/compat/0.1.0
```

`tools.json`, `config.toml` and `get_state.json` are reproducible byte for byte. The
snapshot's file name and `backup_id` end in a random 12-hex suffix, so a regenerated
snapshot differs only in that suffix.
